summary: Master e-commerce marketplace operations with practical tools, scorecards, and fulfilment control. Learn to improve performance and report with confidence.
lede: Running online marketplace trading means keeping product data, pricing, stock, fulfilment, and service performance under control. Designed for e-commerce and digital retail professionals, this course develops practical skills in auditing listings, tracking performance metrics, analyzing pricing and fulfilment exceptions, and planning corrective actions. Learners also practice building scorecards and dashboards to report marketplace health and prioritize operational improvements.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work in e-commerce or digital retail operations and need stronger control over marketplace execution, reporting, and decision-making.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, spreadsheet software, and a working understanding of marketplace or e-commerce reports. Familiarity with Shopify, WooCommerce, Amazon Seller Central, or similar platform dashboards will help, but the workshop is structured so you can follow without advanced technical setup.
